report_label: Subway demo definitions v1 — example analytical assumptions, not verified company policy.
guidance: Use defaults only where the request has not explicitly defined a different measure. State each applied assumption in the report.
Query actual authorized records. Never generate missing operational rows, source identities, currency conversions, business findings or delivery receipts.
These definitions grant no source access, join, approval, policy execution or external action authority.
Use current catalog IDs and supported scalar relationships. If a required field or relationship is absent, report the precise limitation and retain supported independent findings.
Historical snapshot results describe the available snapshot, not current restaurant operations. Calendar labels and profiling dates do not prove business coverage.

definitions.definition: For this demo, unspecified spending means recorded purchase-order value: sum finance.purchaseorders.totalAmount by stored currency. Include all recorded statuses unless the request explicitly supplies a status filter; show a status breakdown so cancelled or draft records remain visible. Label the measure recorded PO value (demo), not approved commitments, cash paid or actual expenses.
evidence_required: recorded PO date when a reporting period is requested

definitions.definition: Restaurant or outlet means a central.stores record for this demo. Finance locations/sites remain their own source identities. Group procurement by a location only when an existing declared source relationship establishes it; never match central stores and finance sites by similar names or numeric IDs.

Rank suppliers using recorded purchase-order vendor identities or labels and recorded PO value by currency. Preserve raw vendor labels when no declared link to central.vendors exists. Do not claim distinct labels identify distinct legal suppliers, deduplicate them, or equate names with vendor IDs.
evidence_required: recorded PO vendor reference or label

definitions.definition: Demo available budget means the stored finance.lineitems.availableAmount at snapshot read time. For an explicitly supplied requested amount, headroom is availableAmount minus requested amount for that exact line item and compatible currency/unit. Negative headroom is an analytical shortfall, not a denied approval. Never infer historical reservations, balances at an earlier date or official budget policy.
evidence_required: requested amount for a proposal comparison

definitions.definition: Pending approval means the source-defined approval_in_progress status on the specifically requested finance approval-record collection, linked to its parent record through an authorized relationship when a parent conclusion is requested. Preserve reconsider, rejected and cancelled as distinct states. A child stage does not establish its parent's final decision.
evidence_required: parent record when a parent conclusion is requested

definitions.definition: Compare an invoice's recorded amount with its linked PO amount only through a supported declared relationship and after establishing compatible currency, scope and grain. Difference is invoice amount minus PO amount; percentage difference is difference divided by nonzero PO amount times 100. A nonzero difference is a review candidate, not proof of overbilling, fraud or payable liability. Missing links and incompatible measures remain separate findings.

Use recorded goods-receipt and PO references for evidence review. A missing or unmatched receipt link means receipt evidence was not established; it does not prove goods were not delivered. Do not multiply order totals through item arrays or repeated receipt rows.
evidence_required: comparable item quantity/unit for quantity conclusions

definitions.definition: For this demo, AOP means Annual Operating Plan and UEM means Unit Economics Model; these expansions are assumptions, not verified company terminology. Treat recorded P&L actual, AOP and UEM collections as separate observations. For comparable measures, actual-minus-plan is the analytical variance; a larger expense is adverse and a larger revenue is favourable only after the source establishes that measure's meaning. Compare only when evidence establishes the same location, period, currency, unit and measure. Revenue, food cost, labour cost and profit cannot be generated when the required source measures are absent.
